This is a nice encapsulation of the issue. Snowden released gobs of information on a bunch of classified, legal programs. Snowden didn't show us a bunch of violations of the law by NSA. Contrary to the impression folks want to give, NSA actually really really dislikes it when people do this and tries hard to prevent it.
